:::: {.panel-tabset .story-tabs .helicity-story-tabs .photon-tag-tabs}

### $\gamma$-переход

```{=html}
<div class="photon-tag-transfer" aria-label="Проекция спина возбуждённого ядра передаётся фотону">
  <div class="photon-tag-object photon-tag-nucleus excited">
    <span class="photon-tag-symbol">\(B^*\)</span>
    <span class="photon-tag-caption">\(J=1\)</span>
    <span class="photon-tag-vector spin up"><i></i><b>\(S_z(B^*)=+1\)</b></span>
  </div>
  <div class="photon-tag-decay">\(\longrightarrow\)</div>
  <div class="photon-tag-products">
    <div class="photon-tag-object photon-tag-nucleus ground">
      <span class="photon-tag-symbol">\(B\)</span>
      <span class="photon-tag-caption">\(J=0\)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="photon-tag-plus">+</div>
    <div class="photon-tag-object photon-tag-photon">
      <span class="photon-tag-symbol">\(\gamma\)</span>
      <span class="photon-tag-vector spin up"><i></i><b>\(S_z(\gamma)=+1\)</b></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

::: {.nh-box tone="success" size="lg" align="center" weight="bold"}

Поскольку конечное ядро имеет спин $0$, фотон уносит проекцию спина
возбуждённого ядра:

$$
m_\gamma=m_{B^*}=\pm1.
$$

:::

### Цепочка меток

**Логика измерения:** проекция спина нейтрино задаёт проекцию $B^*$,
а фотон сохраняет эту метку.

```{=html}
<div class="photon-story-axis"><b>толстая стрелка — спин</b><span>\(+z\)</span><i></i></div>
<div class="photon-story photon-story-single" aria-label="Два перехода переносят спиновую метку нейтрино на фотон">
  <div class="photon-story-node">
    <span class="photon-story-momentum left"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_\nu\)</b></span>
    <span class="photon-story-ball neutrino">\(\nu\)</span>
    <span class="photon-story-spin neutrino right"><i></i></span>
  </div>
  <span class="photon-story-space"></span>
  <div class="photon-story-node source">
    <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus">\(A\)</span>
    <span class="photon-story-caption">\(A+e^-\)</span>
  </div>
  <span class="photon-story-space"></span>
  <div class="photon-story-node">
    <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus excited">\(B^*\)</span>
    <span class="photon-story-spin nucleus left"><i></i></span>
    <span class="photon-story-momentum right"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_{B^*}\)</b></span>
  </div>
  <div class="photon-story-products aligned-products">
    <div class="photon-story-product photon">
      <div class="photon-story-node">
        <span class="photon-story-ball photon">\(\gamma\)</span>
        <span class="photon-story-spin photon left"><i></i></span>
        <span class="photon-story-momentum right"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_\gamma\)</b></span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="photon-story-product">
      <div class="photon-story-node">
        <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus ground">\(B\)</span>
        <span class="photon-story-momentum right"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_B\)</b></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

::: {.nh-box tone="accent" size="lg" align="center" weight="bold"}

Нейтрино не регистрируем: по спину фотона узнаём проекцию $B^*$,
а по ней — проекцию спина нейтрино.

:::
